identity_and_head.title: Request a Titanium Dioxide Quote | TiO2 Malaysia

findings.summary: The all-interactive-target audit fails at every required width.
observations: Inline Privacy Policy link inside the form notice: approximately 92 x 17 px.
findings.test_gap: Gate 8's minTarget assertion only queried controls inside #rfq-form and only measured height; it did not audit links or both dimensions.

findings.summary: The page-specific runtime presentation does not reproduce the approved Gate 5 visual result.
observations: Desktop Website remains a half-width grid item with an empty right column; the approved 1440 asset spans the row.
Approved teal uppercase group dividers are replaced by navy title-case legends without divider rules.
Approved restrained bordered/soft Other request types panel is rendered as an unframed full-width white section.

findings.summary: Native browser UI 200% zoom could not be produced by the in-app browser; Gate 8 only supplied a reflow proxy.

user_scope_decision.basis: The user explicitly stated that the previously described physical-device and assistive-technology evidence is not required. These items are not Gate 9 blockers for this candidate.
